en: A black‑and‑white historic city view showing a busy European square with horse‑drawn carriages and early streetcars in front of a large ornate Neo‑Baroque/Art Nouveau style bank building. The bank has a central dome, statuary on the roofline, and the word "SPARKASSE" above the main entrance and clock. Surrounding it are dense late‑19th‑century townhouses and commercial buildings with steep roofs and shop awnings. In the background, hillside villas and grand hotels rise up a wooded slope, indicating a spa or resort town setting.
